summary: The trace reveals a critical formula bug in the Ending Balance row: formulas referenced the Ending Balance row itself for adds/releases columns (which are empty) instead of the Period Totals row. The verifier failed, indicating the workbook had structural issues despite the agent's claim of success. This update adds Variant C (contract liability) to rebate-rollforward with its unique data structure and filtering, and adds explicit verification guidance to catch the formula reference bug.
